Add parent IDs to a tree data frame

Source: R/trees.R
tree_add_parent.Rd

Given a data frame containing tree nodes in depth-first (preorder) order, with an ID column and a numeric level column, this function adds a parent_id column that identifies the parent of each node.

Usage

tree_add_parent(df, idcol, levelcol)

Arguments

df

A data frame containing tree nodes.

idcol

Name of the column containing node IDs.

levelcol

Name of the column containing numeric levels (depth).

Value

A data frame with an additional column parent_id.

Details

The algorithm uses a stack to keep track of ancestors. When the level increases, the current parent is the previous item on the stack. When the level decreases, the stack is popped until the appropriate ancestor is found. This assumes the rows are in tree order (e.g., as produced by a depth-first traversal).

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  id    = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"),
  level = c(1, 2, 3, 2, 1),
  value = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50)
)
tree_add_parents(df, "id", "level")
#> Error in tree_add_parents(df, "id", "level"): could not find function "tree_add_parents"
